description: Saudi CMI licensed by the CMA (licence no. 23270-32, issued 2023-08-15; commencement letter 2024-07-09) to conduct Managing Investments and Operating Funds, Arranging, and Advising activities. Described in press as the first 'non-traditional' Saudi investment firm licensed by the CMA, focused on real estate, private equity, infrastructure, growth equity, private debt and other real assets — i.e. multi-asset fund management for third-party/institutional capital.

fit.reasoning: Fit: priority segment fund manager (20) + priority market KSA (15) + genuinely multi-asset (real estate, PE, infrastructure, growth equity, private debt) (10) + manages third-party/institutional capital via operated funds (10) + CMA-regulated (5) = 60/60. Timing: licence issued 2023, commencement completed 2024-07 and reconfirmed in a 2025 CMA notice — a fund manager still in its first 1-2 operating years with funds actively being raised/operated across several asset classes, exactly the point spreadsheets stop working (15/25 for fund launch/new asset class, not full new-licence points since the original grant is ~2 years old).
